approveForAll(address,bool).details: MUST emit the ApprovalForAll event on success.

params.approved: True if the operator is approved, false to revoke approval
params.operator: Address to add to the set of authorized operators

params.amounts: Transfer amounts per token type (order and length must match _ids array)
params.ids: IDs of each token type (order and length must match _values array)

initializePool((address,address,address,.details: If the pool is already initialized, this function will not revert

params.activeId: the active bin id of the pool
params.key: the PoolKey of the pool to initialize

lockAcquired(bytes).details: We force the onlyByVault modifier by exposing a virtual function after the onlyByVault check.

params.data: The data that was passed to the call to lock

returns._0: Any data that you want to be returned from the lock call

modifyLiquidities(bytes,uint256).details: This is the standard entrypoint for the PositionManager

params.deadline: is the deadline for the batched actions to be executed
params.payload: is an encoding of actions, and parameters for those actions

modifyLiquiditiesWithoutLock(bytes,bytes.details: This must be called by a contract that has already locked the vault

params.params: the parameters to provide for the actions

msgSender().details: The other context functions, _msgData and _msgValue, are not supported by this contract In many contracts this will be the address that calls the initial entry point that calls `_executeActions` `msg.sender` shouldn't be used, as this will be the vault contract that calls `lockAcquired` If using ReentrancyLock.sol, this function can return _getLocker()

multicall(bytes[]).details: The `msg.value` is passed onto all subcalls, even if a previous subcall has consumed the ether. Subcalls can instead use `address(this).value` to see the available ETH, and consume it using {value: x}.

params.data: The encoded function data for each of the calls to make to this contract

returns.results: The results from each of the calls passed in via data

permit(address,((address,uint160,uint48,.details: this function is payable to allow multicall with NATIVE based actions

params.signature: the signature of the permit; abi.encodePacked(r, s, v)

permitBatch(address,((address,uint160,ui.details: this function is payable to allow multicall with NATIVE based actions

params.signature: the signature of the permit; abi.encodePacked(r, s, v)

params.tokenId: Id of the token that represent position

returns._0: the pool key of the position

batchTransferFrom(address,address,uint25.notice: Transfers `amounts` amount(s) of `ids` from the `from` address to the `to` address specified

initializePool((address,address,address,.notice: Initialize a infinity PCS bin pool

lockAcquired(bytes).notice: Called by the pool manager on `msg.sender` when a lock is acquired

modifyLiquidities(bytes,uint256).notice: Unlocks Vault and batches actions for modifying liquidity

modifyLiquiditiesWithoutLock(bytes,bytes.notice: Batches actions for modifying liquidity without getting a lock from vault

msgSender().notice: function that returns address considered executor of the actions

multicall(bytes[]).notice: Call multiple functions in the current contract and return the data from all of them if they all succeed
